lines: One of these bags is fake. Can you spot it?
Check the stitching. Even, tight, no loose threads on either one.
Look at the hardware. Same gold finish, same weight in your hand.
And the shape holds up exactly the same.
Give up? Here's the only real difference.
This one costs three thousand dollars. This one, about a hundred. Same bag on your arm.
So which one did you pick? Tell me in the comments.
